scope: Official StackChan V1.5.1 Servo Test after idle torque release; simulator verification, no physical-device calibration.

firmware.name: M5Stack StackChan factory
firmware.delivery: Manufacturer image supplied through the existing local-file input; not hosted or committed.

defect.cause: The model required explicit torque=1 after release; SCSCL target-position writes automatically engage torque. Official firmware releases torque during initialization and at rest, then sends WritePos without a separate enable.
defect.beforeNative: Timed Servo Test reached its completion screen without physical movement. A completion screen alone is not an execution assertion.

fix.behavior: Torque defaults to zero. A validated position-mode goal write engages it; explicit torque-off still releases it. REG_WRITE remains deferred until ACTION, and SYNC_WRITE applies the same behavior.
unitChecks: position write after idle torque release
invalid range, reads and unrelated writes do not engage torque
registered writes engage only at ACTION
synchronized position writes engage both servo IDs

reproduction.nativeCommand: ESP32SIM_ROM_DIR=ROM_DIR ESP32SIM_STACKCHAN_FACTORY=FACTORY_BIN ESP32SIM_STACKCHAN_FIXTURE=FIXTURE_MERGED_BIN cargo test --release -p esp32s3 --test stackchan -- --include-ignored
reproduction.nativeInput: Fresh machine: run 3 guest seconds, touch (235,188) for 300 ms, release for 2700 ms, touch (235,188) for 300 ms, release. Observe 400 steps of 40 ms.
reproduction.nativeAssertions: Ordered left >85°, home |pan|<1°, right <-85°, home, up >80°, home tilt<4°; torque enabled during motion and released at rest; actual 320×240 framebuffer.
reproduction.browserInput: Load the same factory image in a fresh workbench, click Welcome Start and Servo Test Start through FT6336 input, observe the full test. Retest, pausing for left/right/up screenshots, then resume to completion.

limitations: Firmware source revision is independent of the binary; not claimed byte-identical.
Pitch home is 2.8125° in this binary, consistent with its 3° lower target clamp and servo quantization.
Position mechanics are unloaded and ideal; PWM rotation, physical zero/direction, torque and collision calibration remain unverified.
Raw console, event streams, device identifiers and screenshots are omitted from Git. Compact ranges and hashes support the result without retaining those fields.
Previous runtime receipts retain their original hashes and describe the earlier build.
